en.description:
Pocket Casino Spinner is a premium casino-style entertainment simulator built for Apple Watch. Crank the Digital Crown, feel the haptic ticks, and watch the wheel spin to a satisfying stop — right on your wrist.

This app is a toy. It does not involve real money. It does not award real prizes. There is no cash value to any in-app activity. Virtual chips cannot be purchased, traded, or withdrawn.

WHAT IS INSIDE

• Mini Roulette: a 13-sector wheel with red, black, and a single green zero. Bet, crank the crown, and watch where it lands.
• Lucky Wheel: a colourful prize wheel of multipliers and losses.
• Slot Reel: classic 3-reel slot animation with chip multipliers.
• Dice: a two-die roller with LOW / HIGH / SEVEN bet types.
• Card Draw: deal a single random playing card and bet on its colour or whether it is an ace.

DIGITAL CROWN CONTROL

Every game accepts Digital Crown input. The faster you crank the crown, the faster the wheel accelerates. As it slows, every passing sector produces a delicate haptic tick. The final result triggers a stronger haptic.

DESIGNED FOR THE SMALL SCREEN

Three themes — Classic gold, Neon, and Minimal — render at full contrast on every Apple Watch size. SwiftUI Canvas keeps the wheel buttery smooth, with no heavy assets.

VIRTUAL BALANCE

You start with 1000 virtual chips. The balance is local to your watch and exists only as a score. You can reset it at any time in Settings. There is no way to buy chips, sell chips, or move them off the device.

PRIVACY

The app collects no data. It does not connect to the internet, does not request location, contacts, microphone, camera, or HealthKit. Nothing leaves the watch.

IMPORTANT

For entertainment only. No real-money gambling. No prizes, payouts, or cash value. The simulated outcomes do not represent or guarantee outcomes in any real casino game. Persons under the legal age in their jurisdiction should not use this app.
en.subtitle: Roulette Toy for Your Wrist
